meta.description: Batch effect correction for CRISPR screens covering ComBat empirical-Bayes, RUV, SVA, control-sgRNA normalization, and batch-aware MAGeCK MLE or Chronos alternatives.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All numerical outcomes in this audit came from disclosed synthetic constructions or the prior public HAP1 subset; no clinical, efficacy, or bibliographic facts were invented.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill concerns pooled CRISPR-screen matrices and makes no individual diagnostic or treatment recommendation.

methodological_ground.detail: The confounding refusal, residual-RSS guard, condition covariate, RUV control handling, and SVA design-factor workflow behaved as documented.

code_usability.detail: Both Python CLIs, the importable ComBat wrapper, RUVg, SVA, NTC normalization, the example, and documented MAGeCK MLE command were executed and asserted on output.

functional_suitability.note: ComBat, covariate modeling, RUV, SVA, NTC scaling, diagnosis, and stop conditions are all covered.

reliability.note: The wrapper exposes uncorrected rows and explicit NaN/confounding failures; direct library calls still rely on underlying package messages.

performance_context.note: The 231-line entry point defers method detail to references and documents the multi-hour genome-scale MLE cost.

agent_usability.note: Decision tree, validation checklist, CLI usage, and common errors are clear; some diagnostic interpretation remains analyst judgment.

human_usability.note: Natural triggers, thresholds, and explicit no-correction cases are easy to discover.

security.note: No credentials or destructive actions appear; CLI table paths are necessarily supplied by the caller.

maintainability.note: Runnable logic is separated into importable scripts and four focused references, each present and parsed.

agent_specific.note: Precise triggering, progressive disclosure, integration points, idempotent file transforms, and escape hatches are strong; MAGeCK permutation p-values are explicitly non-seeded.

inputs.label: Balanced two-batch ComBat CLI
inputs.execution_note: phase2_core_regressions.py generated 600 synthetic sgRNAs, ran both copied CLIs, and parsed corrected.txt.
inputs.note: PC2 detected the planted batch; ComBat reduced PC centroid separation 12.500 to 0.297 while preserving essential-guide LFC.

assertions.text: Copied batch diagnostic CLI executes and reports PC-level batch statistics
assertions.note: Output listed PC1-PC5 and significant batch on PC2.

assertions.text: Copied ComBat CLI writes finite shape-preserving counts
assertions.note: 600 features were written with zero NaN or Inf.

assertions.text: Condition dropout signal remains after correction
assertions.note: Mean essential-guide LFC stayed negative: -1.645 to -1.629.

inputs.label: Unannotated batch with NTC RUVg
inputs.execution_note: phase2_r_regressions.R ran RUVSeq 1.40.0 on a fresh 1,000-guide, 8-sample hidden-batch synthetic matrix.
inputs.note: Character cIdx generated W_1/W_2 and a finite 1000x8 corrected matrix; old integer cIdx was rejected.

assertions.text: RUVg accepts the documented character control rownames
assertions.note: RUVg returned successfully.

assertions.text: RUV output contains two W factors and finite corrected counts
assertions.note: W was 8x2 and corrected counts were 1000x8 without NA.

assertions.text: Old integer cIdx pattern is a genuine regression distinction
assertions.note: The old which()-based invocation returned try-error.

inputs.label: Fully confounded batch and condition
inputs.execution_note: phase2_core_regressions.py called copied combat_correct() on a 250-guide six-sample fully confounded construction.
inputs.note: pyComBat refused the covariate as confounded rather than reporting a spurious correction.

assertions.text: Fully confounded batch plus condition is not silently corrected
assertions.note: ConfoundingVariablesError was raised.

assertions.text: The error identifies confounding
assertions.note: Exception type and text explicitly named the confounded covariate.

assertions.text: The documented redesign/covariate warning is methodologically aligned
assertions.note: Observed refusal agrees with the Skill decision tree.

inputs.label: Batch-aware MAGeCK MLE
inputs.execution_note: phase2_mageck.py launched the current documented command on the prior public HAP1 1,646-gene/6,460-guide subset; phase2_postrun_assert.py parsed its completed output.
inputs.note: The exact --permutation-round 10 command completed with two finite beta columns for 1,646 genes.

assertions.text: The documented MAGeCK MLE command accepts --permutation-round
assertions.note: The flag is present in mageck mle --help and the command completed.

assertions.text: Batch-aware MLE produces a parsed gene result
assertions.note: gene_summary.txt contains 1,646 genes.

assertions.text: No beta value is NaN
assertions.note: Both beta columns were completely finite.

inputs.label: Residual-RSS zero-variance guard
inputs.execution_note: phase2_core_regressions.py used a balanced 120-guide matrix with planted zero-residual and one-batch-constant guides.
inputs.note: Only zero_residual was returned raw; one_batch_constant was corrected and the output was finite.

assertions.text: Zero-residual feature is exposed to the caller
assertions.note: uncorrected contained zero_residual.

assertions.text: Dropped feature retains its raw counts
assertions.note: The returned row exactly equaled the input row.

assertions.text: A guide constant in only one batch remains correctable
assertions.note: one_batch_constant was not in uncorrected and output remained finite.

inputs.label: Bulk RNA-seq request
inputs.execution_note: No computation is applicable: the current SKILL.md scope boundary was inspected directly as the regression input asks whether this CRISPR-screen Skill should be used for bulk RNA-seq.
inputs.note: The Skill explicitly says ComBat/RUV/SVA methods generalize but CRISPR-specific controls, validation, and MAGeCK/Chronos guidance do not.

assertions.text: The Skill identifies its CRISPR-screen boundary
assertions.note: Related but out of scope section is explicit.

assertions.text: It does not claim CRISPR validation criteria apply to RNA-seq
assertions.note: It directs the user to replace screen-specific checks.

assertions.text: It supplies a safe alternative framing
assertions.note: It retains the general method but defers assay validation to the relevant workflow.

inputs.label: Force ComBat with no batch signal
inputs.execution_note: phase2_core_regressions.py ran copied combat_correct() on 350 guides independently Poisson-sampled into arbitrary batch labels.
inputs.note: The forced call stayed finite with no uncorrected rows, supporting the stated pre-fit guard/backstop behavior while the decision tree says correction should normally be declined.

assertions.text: No-batch forced correction does not return NaN or Inf
assertions.note: All returned values were finite.

assertions.text: Output shape is preserved
assertions.note: 350x8 shape matched input.

assertions.text: The Skill warns not to use correction without diagnosed batch effect
assertions.note: When NOT to Correct includes this condition.

inputs.label: Standalone screen example
inputs.execution_note: phase2_example.ps1 ran copied examples/batch_correct.py in an audit-only output directory and parsed qc_metrics.csv.
inputs.note: The example detected 15/15 planted hits with zero false positives and wrote parsed QC metrics.

assertions.text: Standalone example completes
assertions.note: Exited successfully.

assertions.text: Example writes a usable QC artifact
assertions.note: qc_metrics.csv was present and parsed.

assertions.text: Planted hits are recovered
assertions.note: 15 hits and true-positive rate 1.0.

inputs.label: SVA plus NTC anchoring
inputs.execution_note: phase2_r_regressions.R ran the current SVA pattern and NTC anchored normalization on the fresh Input 2 matrix.
inputs.note: SVA found one surrogate variable and generated an 8x3 design; all 300 NTC medians were exactly 1000 after anchoring.

assertions.text: SVA returns a finite augmented design matrix
assertions.note: One SV produced an 8x3 design without NA.

assertions.text: NTC normalization uses the declared controls
assertions.note: 300 named NTC rows supplied the scale factors.

assertions.text: Anchored medians reach the requested target
assertions.note: Every sample NTC median equaled 1000 within 1e-9.

key_strengths: Every runnable Python and R method was executed from an audit-owned copy of the exact source-tip files.
The residual-RSS ComBat guard correctly returns named raw rows without over-dropping a one-batch-constant guide.
The Skill refuses a fully confounded covariate design and documents an explicit batch-aware MLE alternative.
The MAGeCK command includes an actual supported permutation flag and its completed gene output has no NaN beta values.

recommendations.title: State JACKS compatibility or remove version implication
recommendations.problem: JACKS is named as an alternative but Version Compatibility does not state which JACKS release/API was considered.
recommendations.root_cause: The compatibility section concentrates on tools directly executed by the primary path.
recommendations.fix: Add a brief JACKS version/API compatibility note, or label it as a cross-reference to the dedicated JACKS Skill rather than a tested in-skill dependency.
